messages:
ashok: heads up — seeing scrape-manager churn in eu-west-1. kubelet is returning 503 for a subset of nodes and prometheus remote_write queues are growing fast. noticed a cardinality spike too.

maria: how big are the queues? grafana panel?

ashok: grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/ops/prom-scrape-queue — per-shard queue went from ~200 to 18k in 12m. remote_write spikes to 5k req/s retries.

prometheus-bot: ALERT Fired: PrometheusRemoteWriteQueueDepth (severity=page) — shard=eu-west-1-a value=18342

leah: any recent relabel changes or pod annotations that could cause cardinality?

ashok: yes — platform deploy added pod_annotation "git.commit_sha" on every rollout. looks like we ended up labeling many metrics with that annotation during scrape relabeling.

sam: ugh. that explains the cardinality. can you paste the prometheus scrape relabel_config?

ashok: sure:

```
- job_name: 'kubernetes-pods'
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: pod
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_git_commit_sha"]
    action: replace
    target_label: "git_sha"
```

ashok: that target_label is the culprit — git_sha varies every deploy.

leah: immediate fix: drop that relabel or change to action: "labeldrop" with regex 'git_.*' or use "replacement: ''". also we should add a relabel to drop high-card labels entirely at scrape time.

sam: short-term mitigation: throttle remote_write retries and increase remote_write queue_capacity on eu-west shards so Prometheus doesn't OOM or keep retrying non-idempotent writes. also consider pausing any CI that causes mass restarts.

leah: config suggestion to drop the label (apply ASAP):

```
- source_labels: ["__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_git_commit_sha"]
  action: labeldrop
  regex: ".*"
```

leah: or explicitly rename to git_sha with empty replacement: action: replace, replacement: "" — but labeldrop is cleaner.

sam: for remote_write backoff, we pushed this yesterday to staging but not prod. settings to tweak: max_backoff, max_retries, queue_config: {max_samples_per_send: 10000, batch_send_deadline: 5s, capacity: 25000}.

ashok: i'm going to toggle the relabel in eu-west config and roll one shard. will also pause the largest CI job.

maria: can you also add an alert for sudden label entropy/cardinality deltas? we only have queue depth alerts right now.

leah: yes — add a low-noise alert that compares "label_count" or use promql: increase(count by (__name__)({job="kubernetes-pods"})[10m]) > 1000 or something similar. will draft after we stabilise.

prometheus-bot: NOTE: config push queued to prom-config:eu-west.

deploy-bot: roll started: prom-config eu-west-1-shard-3 (user=ashok)

ashok: rolled relabel out to shard-3. queues dropping from 18k -> 800 in 6m. continuing rollout. will follow up with PR to remove git_commit annotations from metrics pipeline.
